params.prompt: Create one original premium Y2K Futurism / Soft Club CGI asset for a working music discovery website. Optimistic 1999–2002 imagined technology, future plus nostalgia. Ice blue, pearl white, liquid silver, cobalt reflections, tiny ocean-green accents. Meticulously rendered glass/refraction/metal, confident sculptural silhouette and optical depth. No people, faces, brands, logos, letters, typography, numbers, UI, controls, watermarks, fake technical text, grids, collage, neon cyberpunk, purple neon, or starfield. Produce artwork only, never a website screenshot. LANDSCAPE 16:9 background environment: a vast luminous pale-blue optical space, translucent aerodynamic acrylic waves flowing diagonally from upper-right to lower-right, a single polished liquid-silver curved conduit at the extreme right edge, soft distant white cloud reflections seen THROUGH rippling glass, a subtle glossy blue floor reflecting silver light. Right half expressive and dimensional; LEFT 48 percent almost empty pearl-white mist, center transition clean and restrained. Broad glass forms, not tiny clutter. Crisp cobalt depths at rightmost edge, icy white daylight through the center. No disc or sphere: the website already has a separate 3D disc. No enclosing border. Why this works (composition rationale, do not draw text): luminous depth behind the existing disc with a quiet left half preserves search readability.
